notes: IPC streams use 1-based indexing: video1=main, video2=sub, video3=third. NVR unicast paths use c<N> for channel (1-based) and s0/s1 for main/sub stream. Default RTSP port is 554. RTSP authentication uses standard rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/{path} prefix. H.264 and H.265 share the same URL path — codec is selected by camera profile configuration. The leads /unicast/c1/s1/live and /unicast/c2/s1/live from StrixCamDB match the NVR sub-stream pattern (s1); the main-stream lead /unicast/c1/s0/live also matches.
